text: In addition to the previous list, there are a few caveats for the safe implementation of a strength training and conditioning program. First, strength training and conditioning activities should be planned, and the required number of qualified staff should be present. Second, recommended guidelines should be followed during peak usage times for minimum average floor space allowance per participant (100 ft 2 ), coach-to-athlete ratios (1:10 junior high school, 1:15 high school, 1:20 college), and number of participants per barbell or training station (up to 3).
